title: Internet of Things — OT & IoT Security Services
description: Strengthen the security of your organization's connected objects with the IoT security service designed by Victrix's cybersecurity experts.

sections.title: Internet of Things — OT & IoT Security Services
sections.lead: Secure your organization's connected devices — Internet of Things and operational technologies — with our comprehensive cybersecurity offering for OT and IoT. From needs analysis to continuous real-time monitoring, we reduce the risk of attacks and guarantee the integrity of your data.

sections.title: Why Secure Your Organization's Connected Objects?

featured.title: Reduce your attack surface
featured.text: IoT cybersecurity is a major issue for organizations. The growing number of devices and objects connected to the network expands your attack surface and increases your vulnerability.

aside.title: An industry-leading security service
aside.text: Enhance device security and reduce the risk of data breaches with Victrix's industry-leading OT and IoT security service.

sections.subtitle: Victrix performs a comprehensive analysis of your infrastructure to identify security risks and improve the resilience of IoT environments.

sections.title: Victrix Ensures the Security of IoT and OT Systems
sections.intro: Complete support, from the assessment of your IoT networks to the adoption of new technologies by your teams.

bullets.text: In-depth assessment of your specific needs and the current state of your IoT network security
Inventory of connected objects and identification of the associated vulnerabilities
Definition of a secure IoT architecture tailored to your needs, taking scalability and performance into account
Rapid intervention procedures to respond to any unauthorized access or failure
Comprehensive technical support, including proactive maintenance plans and regular security software updates
Training sessions to familiarize your teams with IoT best practices
Personalized support to ensure successful adoption of new technologies

sections.title: Sector-Specific Expertise in OT/IoT and Cybersecurity
paragraphs: Our tailored IoT security service addresses the specific challenges of OT and IoT within your industry. Our cybersecurity experts have in-depth knowledge of industrial systems, enabling them to counter threats specific to your industry, ensure business continuity, and guarantee the security of your IoT environments and connected devices.
Victrix is your strategic partner for an enhanced, scalable IoT service: personalized, robust, and reliable IoT as a service to provide your organization with an optimal level of protection.
